description: This Java source file defines the `ProcessorHelper` class, which provides utility methods for configuring HTTP clients, especially for creating insecure SSL contexts, and setting up webhooks using Retrofit and OkHttpClient. It also includes methods for creating callbacks for asynchronous HTTP requests.

classes.name: ProcessorHelper
classes.description: A utility service class that provides methods for configuring insecure HTTP clients, creating Retrofit webhooks, and handling callbacks, with special attention to SSL/TLS settings and logging.

methods.name: ProcessorHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SSL context based on whether insecure HTTP clients are enabled.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates and configures an OkHttpClient instance, including insecure SSL settings if enabled.

methods.name: configureInsecureClient
methods.description: Configures an OkHttpClient.Builder to trust all SSL certificates and hostnames, enabling insecure connections.

methods.name: createInsecureSSLContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext that trusts all certificates, used for insecure HTTPS connections.

methods.name: createCallback
methods.description: Creates a Retrofit callback that logs response status or errors for the given URL.

methods.name: createWebHookService
methods.description: Builds and returns a WebHookService instance configured with the specified URL.
